responsibility: Validates and holds the sixteen-field module contracts and the invariants over them.
failure_boundary: fail_closed — an incomplete, malformed, duplicated or invariant-violating contract is refused before it is recorded anywhere
recovery_behavior: Stateless validator; re-reads the contract documents from disk on the next load and reports the same deterministic verdict, so an interrupted load leaves nothing partially registered
replacement_contract: A replacement must enforce the same sixteen required fields, refuse unexpected fields, and preserve the five registry invariants; callers depend only on ContractRegistry.get, dependency_order, authority_owners and registry_hash
evidence_produced: ContractError detail naming the violated rule and module
